title: Menagerie crawler operator requeue-grant void v1
description: One append-only operator void of an existing requeue grant. A void never deletes or rewrites the grant; already-recorded consumptions stand as history. The void_id content hash deliberately excludes created_at so an identical void command stays idempotent across re-invocations; schema_version is likewise outside the preimage. Rows minted before this version carry no schema_version and remain readable forever (docket T2-12).

void_id.description: Canonical void identity over void_of, reason, and voided_by.

void_of.description: Exact grant_id being voided; must already exist in the ledger.

voided_by.description: Operator identity that voided the grant.

created_at.description: UTC issue timestamp; outside the void identity by design.
